newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goldtron sees better results this year.
newsitem.headline: Goldtron sees better results this year.

text.p: Goldtron Ltd said on Thursday it expected to perform better this year due to its focus on the Asia-Pacific region and new products coming into the market.

In a statement accompanying its 1996 results, it said the relocation of certain sub-contract manufacturing facilities offshore which disrupted productivity, accounted for lower profits in the first half of 1996.
Increased expenditure from the development of new products and services would provide an investment platform for continued growth, it said.
The group had an extraordinary profit of S$4.8 million.
This was a net amount from the disposal of interests in subsidiary companies, offset by a loss from discontinued projects and operations and losses or provisions in long term investments.
